transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Once I start talking, I just can’t seem to stop—I feel like I have to get every idea out all at once and people keep telling me I’m overwhelming them. It actually got to the point where HR at my startup strongly recommended I seek an urgent evaluation because I've been derailing meetings, so I'm here to figure out how to slow down.

Have there been distinct periods lasting several days when you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep, and were more impulsive than usual? Or has this fast talking and racing mind been a more lifelong, steady pattern for you?

This definitely isn't a lifelong pattern—it actually just started about two months ago after I got a big promotion at my startup. Before this, my mood and sleep were completely normal, but now I feel incredibly wired and barely need any rest. It's a very sudden, intense change from my usual self.

Before this energized period started, have you ever had a separate episode lasting at least two weeks when you felt very depressed or lost interest in things most of the day, nearly every day? If so, did it interfere with your work or daily life?

No, I don't recall ever having a period of feeling very depressed or losing interest in things like that. Before this energized period started, my mood generally just felt normal. I've never had a time where I felt down for weeks at a time.

Before this current episode, have you ever had any other separate periods of unusually high energy, needing less sleep, feeling more confident, or being more impulsive that lasted several days or longer? Or is this the first time anything like this has ever happened?

This is completely the first time anything like this has ever happened to me. Before this, my mood and energy levels were always very normal and stable. I've never had a time in the past where I felt this revved up or barely needed to sleep.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a first distinct episode of persistently elevated/energized state beginning abruptly 2 months ago, with pressured speech, racing thoughts, markedly decreased need for sleep, and impairment at work requiring urgent evaluation. There is no history of prior depressive episodes or prior similar elevated episodes, supporting a current manic episode without psychotic symptoms.
